scope: Complete supplied main: publisher cover plus three scientific pages, four figures, Table I and 21-reference bibliography. SI and cited full articles unreviewed.

bibliographic_scope.title: Nanocrystalline CdS-water-soluble conjugated-polymers: High performance photoelectrochemical cells
bibliographic_scope.authors: Wonjoo Lee; Rajaram S. Mane; Sun-Ki Min; Tae Hyun Yoon; Sung-Hwan Han; Soo-Hyoung Lee

source_interpretation.text: The authors report approximately 7 ± 1 nm CdS particles, approximately 20 nm sharp-edged aggregates, approximately 8.2 nm Scherrer grains and approximately 150 nm film thickness. These describe different objects and are not interchangeable. The statistic represented by ±1 nm is not identified.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Film preparation, Figure 1 and structural discussion

source_interpretation.text: SAED has diffuse rings, which the authors associate with significant amorphous and/or less nanocrystalline structure. Indexed (100)/(002) planes and preferential [100]/[002] growth are reported; no explicit polymorph name, unit-cell constants or coordinates are provided here.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, Figure 1 and structural discussion

source_interpretation.topic: Hydrophilic interface is the proposed advantage
source_interpretation.text: Quaternary pyridinium salts render the otherwise hydrophobic conjugated polymers water-soluble. The authors argue that compatible hydrophilic surfaces improve sensitizer contact with CdS. The measured bare-film water contact angle is about 15 degrees; the introduction’s less-than-10-degree statement is a general background description, not this measured value.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Introduction, Figure 1d and polymer discussion

source_interpretation.text: LM 3 has greater measured adsorption than LM 2 and higher reported cell efficiency. The authors attribute this to carboxyl-mediated electronic coupling and improved electron transfer. This is their interpretation; adsorption density, optical tail and cell performance are retained as distinct evidence, not direct structural proof of a particular surface bond.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3–4, Figure 3, Figure 4 and Table I

source_interpretation.text: The source gives positive LUMO values of 3.23 and 3.42 eV with normal hydrogen electrode for LM 2/LM 3, and a CdS conduction-band value of 4.2 eV in its interpretation. The underlying CV curves are not shown. The values are not converted to vacuum energies, sign-corrected or treated as new measured CdS band levels.

structural_scope.CdS: Own Figure 1 microscopy/diffraction and water contact-angle panels characterize the bare CdS/ITO film. No separate microscopy is supplied for each polymer-sensitized film.
structural_scope.phase: Planes (100)/(002) and growth [100]/[002] reported; no explicit polymorph name/cell refinement. Diffuse SAED rings preserve the source crystallinity qualification.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Film preparation and Figure 1

polymer_preparation.precursors: Figure2 depicts 2-ethynylpyridine plus Br(CH2)3A, A=NH2 or COOH; source calls it alkyl halide.
polymer_preparation.workup: Pour into excess diethyl ether, filter, air-dry35 °C for unspecified duration.
polymer_preparation.polymerization: No chain length, yield, molecular mass, molecular-weight distribution or stereochemical characterization results are numerically given.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Polymer preparation and Figure 2

coating_and_assay.coating: Dip CdS film in0.1mol/L aqueous polymer solution. Concentration basis, time,temperature,washing/drying and thickness unspecified.
coating_and_assay.desorption: Adsorbed polymer dissolved in1mMKOH for quantitativeUV–vis; destructive analytical branch, not the cell electrolyte.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, Coating and adsorption paragraphs

table1.title: Voc, Jsc, FF and efficiency of solar cells
table1.conditions: AM1.5,80mW/cm2; stated photosensitizerarea2.5×2.5cm2. No numerical rederivation.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 4, Table I; abstract p2 and method p3

optical_context.CdS_band_scope: Source interpretation/reference value, not a new direct band measurement assigned to this CdS preparation.
optical_context.LM3_IPCE: up to70% at490nm; graph not digitized

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3–4, Figures3–4 and optical/electrochemical discussion

instruments: GPC:photoluminescence gel Mixed-B×2, as printed; no numerical molecular-weight results
FTIR:ATI Mattson Genesis series; spectra/results not presented here
